shelters.name: Oklahoma Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded 2007 to end needless euthanasia. Formal partnership with Oklahoma City Animal Shelter - majority of animals transferred from City shelter.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Tulsa
shelters.description: Private nonprofit committed to responsible pet ownership and population control. Can respond to emergency and disaster situations with rescue, sheltering, and vet services.

shelters.name: Northern Oklahoma Humane Society
shelters.description: Nonprofit shelter committed to dog and cat adoption, animal welfare promotion, and low-cost spay/neuter services. Reunites lost pets and finds homes for abandoned animals.

shelters.name: Safe Haven Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit dedicated to finding homes for homeless and abandoned animals in OKC metro. 100% volunteer, no agency funding, no-kill rescue.

shelters.name: Tulsa SPCA
shelters.description: Aims to improve the lives of dogs and cats, as well as their human companions in the Tulsa area.

shelters.name: Pets & People Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Yukon and the Oklahoma City metro west area.

shelters.name: Free To Live
shelters.description: Provides housing and medical care for homeless dogs and cats, adoption program, and education on responsible pet ownership.

shelters.name: Second Chance Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Norman and central Oklahoma area.

shelters.name: Oklahoma Pet Collective Society
shelters.description: Animal rescue collective serving the Oklahoma City metropolitan area.

shelters.name: Mutt Misfits Society
shelters.description: Dog rescue organization serving Oklahoma City and surrounding communities.

shelters.name: Rogers County Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Rogers County in northeastern Oklahoma.

shelters.name: Okmulgee Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Okmulgee and surrounding eastern Oklahoma communities.

shelters.name: Sapulpa Furry Friends
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Sapulpa and Creek County in eastern Oklahoma.

shelters.name: Maltese Rescue of OKC
shelters.description: Breed-specific rescue for Maltese dogs in the Oklahoma City area.

shelters.name: Muskogee Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Municipal animal shelter serving Muskogee and surrounding area in eastern Oklahoma.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Oklahoma animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Oklahoma Humane Society founded 2007 with formal city shelter partnership. Humane Society of Tulsa provides disaster response services. Coverage spans Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Norman, Ponca City, Claremore, and surrounding communities.
